subject: Experience needs: onboarding.run()/mount() returning a confirmed Profile, plus calibration
body: The app gives you the Onboard and Calibrate screen slots. I need one entry point that yields a schema-valid Profile v2 (run() -> Profile, or mount(el, {onDone})) and the calibration step writing emotions[i].calibration. For the demo, please make a scripted conversation that finishes in about 60 s, runs offline, and can be fast-forwarded. I'll run on a fixture stub until yours lands.
